decisions.what_changed: The save that the results page downloads, shares or copies as a code now holds the notes settings kept on this device, read when the button is pressed. save/io.ts: deviceBriefPrefs(storage = localStorage) reads every readable autosave on the device (hb:save:v1:*, the notes page's prefs-only autosave and the copy each session autosave carries) and joins their brief_prefs with mergeBriefPrefs, i.e. exactly what the notes page's store load() shows; withDeviceBriefPrefs(save, device) joins that into the save (save/brief-prefs.ts withBriefPrefs: higher rev wins per slot, fit notes a union, removals kept; merge rules unchanged), returns the save itself when the device adds nothing, and falls back to the save itself if the joined file would not pass validateSave. Same content rules as the notes page's save (R-17.12: enums, ids, versions and months only; nothing typed can be there, the schema admits none). The file-level sig and the sessions are untouched (brief_prefs is outside the signed part, R-17.1). reveal/SavePanel.svelte calls it at the click in doDownload, doShare and doCopy (all synchronous, before any await, so user activation holds), via a new injectable prop deviceNotes. After a download or share whose file holds notes settings, a muted line says so. A second device that loads the file gets the settings back through the notes page's existing 'Load my settings from a save' (restoreBriefPrefs), verified by a round trip into fresh storage. The server mirror is unchanged: it still gets makeSave() from Finished/ServedPanels, so the mirror holds no notes settings (R-17.1; MIRROR_NOTE stays true).

strings.before: (results-page save had no brief_prefs unless the session had started from a save that carried them) => on the notes page of a second device: 'That save has no notes settings.'
strings.after: the save holds them; the second device loads them ('loadDone')

The file also holds the notes settings kept on this device: your choices, never text you typed. (shown under the 'Saved as ...' line, only after a download or share whose file holds notes settings; data-notes-included)

deviations: The copy save code and the share sheet's file carry the notes settings too, not only the download: it is the same save ('one file per person'), session-save.spec.ts already pins that the code decodes to the same save as the file, and a code without them would leave the 'no notes settings' message on the paste route. Strictly, D17 names only the download.

A small 'The file also holds the notes settings ...' line was added under the save panel (not asked for): the file now holds more than the person's answers, and the person may hand it on. Easy to drop (SavePanel.svelte, share-save-copy.ts).

Notes settings are treated as the device's, as on the notes page: the join takes every autosave on the device whatever its anon_id (an anon_id filter was tried and dropped because a person who only views results, with no autosave yet, and then keeps notes in another tab gets a different minted id on the notes page, so their own settings would have been left out).

Consequence for the ready screen's 'Add my new session to the earlier saves on this device' choice when it is cleared: e2e/session-save.spec.ts 'the file's notes settings win the same way when the new session is not added to the earlier saves on the device' expected the downloaded file to hold 'nothing of the device's second set'. With D17 the file holds the file's slot 1 (rev one above the device's) and the device's second set. I changed that one expectation to [{...fileFirst, rev: mineFirst.rev + 1}, mineSecond] with a comment. The choice still decides what sessions the save holds; it no longer keeps the device's notes settings out of the download.
open_issues: OWNER VIEW NEEDED: should leaving earlier saves out also keep this device's notes settings out of the results-page save (e.g. two people on one device)? If yes, SessionApp must pass a flag down (ReadyState.includeFound false => deviceNotes: () => undefined) through Finished.svelte and Reveal.svelte to SavePanel; SavePanel already takes the injectable `deviceNotes` prop. See requests.

If the person removes their notes settings on the notes page in another tab while the results are open, the running session's in-memory base (session/persist.ts #base) may still carry them, and the join cannot tell removal from absence, so the file would still hold them. This was already so for the session's own autosave and download before D17; not changed.
Reading all autosaves at the click parses and validates each (a few ms for ten sessions). It only runs on the three buttons.

decisions.what_changed: Local calendar date in both file names. save/io.ts: new localDateStamp(date) (YYYY-MM-DD from the Date's local getters; reads no clock; throws RangeError on an invalid Date) and saveFileName(save) now dates the file with the local day of save.created_utc (the moment the save was made: currentSave() stamps it with the wall clock at the press, so this is the day of the download), falling back to the UTC date text only when created_utc is not a real time. The section-8 shape humanbench-<shortid>-<YYYY-MM-DD>.hbsave.json is kept. viz/export.ts: cardFileName(kind, date, theme) now returns humanbench-card-<light|dark>-<local date>.<png|svg> (theme is a required third argument; ShareCard passes the colours chosen at the press, for the PNG download, the SVG download and the share sheet). The notes page's own download goes through the same saveFileName, so it is local too. created_utc inside the file stays UTC.
